info.title: minimax/minimax-h3-image-highspeed
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "minimax/minimax-h3-image-highspeed", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: The MiniMax H3-Image fields, shared by the v1 `POST /proxy/minimax/v1/images/generations` request body and the Comfy Router input schema for `minimax/minimax-h3-image` and `minimax/minimax-h3-image-highspeed`. Without `images` the request is text-to-image; with `images` it runs as an image edit.

example.prompt: A single red maple leaf resting on a plain white background.

area.description: Output area level when `size` is omitted or `auto`. One of `1K`, `2K`, `4K` (default).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio when `size` is omitted or `auto`. `auto` (default) or `X:Y` between 1:3 and 3:1, such as `16:9`.

disable_prompt_enhanced.description: Turns MiniMax's prompt enhancement off. Requires a fixed `size` or an `X:Y` `aspect_ratio`.

images.description: Optional reference images. When present the request runs as an image edit, exactly as on the edits route.

model.description: Model name. `MiniMax-H3-Image` or `MiniMax-H3-Image-Highspeed`. Router callers may omit this field or send null; Router fills in the model selected by the request path.

n.description: Number of images. Input tokens are charged once per image.

prompt.description: Text description of the image. With `images`, the description of the edit; the reference images are image 1, image 2 and so on, in array order.

size.description: Output size, `auto` (default) or `WIDTHxHEIGHT` such as `2720x1536`. A fixed size must have an area of 655,360 to 20,000,000 pixels and an aspect ratio between 1:3 and 3:1, and cannot be combined with `aspect_ratio` or `area`.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for MiniMax H3-Image and H3-Image Highspeed: MiniMax's `MinimaxImagesResponse` document, forwarded unchanged. The call is synchronous, so this is the body of the run response.
Each generated image is at `data[].url`. Router does not re-host the images: the URLs are MiniMax's own links and expire, so download promptly rather than storing the link. `data[].size` is the actual `WIDTHxHEIGHT`. An image that failed or was withheld by MiniMax's content safety check carries only `error`. `usage` counts the successful images only, and the call is billed on its token counts.

image_url.description: A public http(s) URL or a `data:image/<format>;base64,` URI. JPEG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC or HEIF, each side 128 to 8192 px, long side at most 4 times the short side.

error.description: Present only when this image failed or was withheld.

revised_prompt.description: The prompt MiniMax used for this image.

url.description: URL of the generated image. It expires, so download the image.

MinimaxImageUsage.description: Token usage of the successful images. Billing is based on it.
